examples.english: A telegram arrived from my father to let me know about an urgent matter.

notes:
{電報|でんぽう} refers to telegrams, which are still used in Japan for formal occasions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {電報|でんぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧/⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to send a telegram
- {電報|でんぽう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: telegram arrives
- {電報|でんぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive a telegram

TYPES:
- ⟦{祝電|しゅくでん}→祝電：22862_shukuden⟧: congratulatory telegram (weddings, etc.)
- ⟦{弔電|ちょうでん}→弔電：22863_chouden⟧: condolence telegram (funerals)

CULTURAL NOTE:
While telegrams are obsolete for everyday communication, they remain important for formal Japanese occasions. Sending a ⟦{祝電|しゅくでん}→祝電：22862_shukuden⟧ to weddings is still a common practice.

Note: NTT still offers telegram services in Japan.
